6966 Oliver Wendell Holmes 1809-1894 John Bartlett

 
 
 
NUMBER:
6966
 
AUTHOR:
Oliver Wendell Holmes
 (1809–1894)
 
QUOTATION:
  I firmly believe that if the whole 
materia medica
 could be sunk to the bottom of the sea, it would be all the better for mankind and all the worse for the fishes.
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Lecture, Harvard Medical School.
